contexts.text: And called her name Dinah () = the quality... The quality which Dinah represents and signifies is everything of the Church of faith in which there is good... In the Original Language, Dinah means judgment.
Dinah went out () = the affection of all things of faith, and the Church thence; (for) Dinah = the affection of all truths, and the Church thence. References, Explained. AC 4437. AC 4449.
For by Dinah is represented the external Church, such as was instituted with the descendants of Jacob.

Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter () = conjunction not lawful with the affection of truth, which is of the external Church here represented by Jacob.... Dinah = the affection of all things of faith and the Church thence.
The conjunction of the interior truth, which is Shechem, with the affection of exterior truth, which is Dinah.
Dinah, who is here the daughter of Jacob = the affection of truth of the Ancient Church.
The brethren of Dinah () = the truths and goods of that Church... Dinah = the affection of truth, thus the Church.
They took Dinah out of the house of Shechem, and departed () = that they took away the affection of truth from those who were of the remains of the Most Ancient Church.

Sister, here, = the truth of faith; because by Dinah, who here is the sister, is signified the affection of all things of faith... And as she was not given by her brethren to Shechem for a woman, but remained with them defiled, afterwards by her is represented the opposite... namely, the affection of all falsities, thus a corrupt Church. AC 4522.
And Dinah his daughter () = the Church.
